summary: Backend: 19/20 tests pass. Auth, documents, presets, dashboard, damage matrix, generator (LLM draft + PDF/DOCX export), vault (stats/search/dataset) all work. CRITICAL: full Orchestrator run (POST /api/orchestrator/run + polling) always FAILS because the Emergent LLM key on this environment has concurrency=1 while server.py:312 uses asyncio.gather to run A1/A2/A3 in parallel -> 429 concurrent_request_limit. Frontend: login works with admin credentials, redirect to /app/dashboard sticks (no race-condition bounce), all 6 nav tabs load, all documented data-testid selectors are present on the Orchestrator (load-preset-button, cluster-a-run-orchestrator-button, case-text-input). Full end-to-end orchestrator UI run was NOT executed because backend concurrency bug guarantees failure.

critical.issue: Wave 1 uses asyncio.gather for A1/A2/A3, but Emergent LLM key allows only 1 concurrent request -> job status='failed' with 'litellm.RateLimitError ... concurrent_request_limit'. Every orchestration run fails. Fix: run A1->A2->A3 sequentially (replace asyncio.gather in server.py _run_orchestration Wave 1 with a for-loop) OR add a semaphore(1) around ag.run_agent calls.

integration_issues.issue: UI will always show 'failed' status because backend orchestration crashes on parallel LLM call. Blocked by backend critical bug above.

action_items: URGENT: In /app/backend/server.py _run_orchestration Wave 1, replace `results = await asyncio.gather(*[do_agent(a) for a in wave1])` with a sequential loop (`for a in wave1: results.append(await do_agent(a))`) so LLM calls respect the Emergent key concurrency=1 limit. Same applies anywhere else parallel LLM calls could occur.
After the fix, retest full orchestrator flow (expect ~90-150s runtime, still under 180s budget) and confirm UI shows 5 agent cards idle->running->done, bus log populates, synthesis-panel appears.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:312 asyncio.gather over 3 LLM agents is incompatible with a concurrency=1 LLM key; must be sequential or gated by a semaphore.
server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=True with an explicit FRONTEND_URL origin — good. But .env also has CORS_ORIGINS="*" which is unused; consider removing to avoid confusion.
server.py:71-72 cookies set samesite='none' + secure=True require HTTPS — fine for preview but will break local http testing.

server.py get_current_user uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) but register/login store users with default Mongo _id (ObjectId). OK. However token has no role claim — role is re-fetched from DB each request (acceptable).
agents.py uses one shared EMERGENT_LLM_KEY across many concurrent sessions; add a global asyncio.Semaphore(1) wrapper to make this robust regardless of caller.
server.py is 577 lines and mixes auth, documents, orchestrator, damage, generator, vault — should be split into routers for maintainability.

rca of the issue: Root cause: server.py:312 `results = await asyncio.gather(*[do_agent(a) for a in wave1])` fires 3 concurrent LlmChat.send_message calls. The Emergent LLM key in this environment enforces concurrency_request_limit=1 (litellm 429). The first agent succeeds; the two others 429; asyncio.gather raises; the except block marks job status='failed' and stores the error. Reproduction: POST /api/orchestrator/run with any case_text, then poll GET /api/orchestrator/run/{id} -> status flips to 'failed' within a few seconds with error containing 'CONCURRENCY_REQUEST_LIMIT'. Mitigation: sequential loop OR asyncio.Semaphore(1) gating ag.run_agent.
